headline: As of 2026-10-16: 7,186,684 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+20.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 7,186,684 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+20.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (859,782), Florida (757,690), Virginia (635,346).
